title: Codec capacity: longer training and a deeper encoder at dropout 0.3
description: Step 3 of the plan (docs/methodology.md). Two checks that the codec of release exp-codec-dropout-6 is trained as well as it can be within a runner's 6 hours: epochs13 trains 13 epochs in place of 10, because the validation loss was still falling in the last epoch; depth6 gives the encoder 6 blocks in place of 4, because the search's winner (release exp-codec-search-3) was the largest network on its grid. Each runs at 6 latents (fixed6, the knee) and at 64 latents (wide64), every latent kept, dropout 0.3, seeds 0 to 2. Baselines: drop0.3-fixed6 of exp-codec-dropout-6 and drop0.3-wide64 of exp-codec-variants-5. Other settings as there (learning rate 1e-3, width 512, weight decay 1e-4, all training anchors of release exp-phase0-steps-2, links split 70/15/15 with split seed 0). Scores are on validation links only; the test links are not read.
run: VARIANT=${JOB%%-*}; REST=${JOB#*-}; MODEL=${REST%-s*}; SEED=${JOB##*-s}; case "$MODEL" in fixed6) K=6;; wide64) K=64;; *) exit 2;; esac; case "$VARIANT" in epochs13) EPOCHS=13; DEPTH=4;; depth6) EPOCHS=10; DEPTH=6;; *) exit 2;; esac; uv run python experiments/codec.py train "$OUT/runs/$JOB" --data "$IN/steps" --set dropout=0.3 --set k=$K --set nested=false --set seed=$SEED --set lr=0.001 --set width=512 --set depth=$DEPTH --set dec_width=512 --set weight_decay=0.0001 --set epochs=$EPOCHS --set time_budget_s=19800
collect: uv run python experiments/codec_report.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/runs/*; find "$OUT/runs" -name model.pt -delete
